functionality: Kivilo uploads the property inspection photos and narrated videos that an inspector has just captured and saved. A foreground service continues the media transfer when the inspector leaves the app, with an upload progress notification. The original files stay in the local durable queue until storage and capture registration are confirmed.
deferralImpact: Deferring the transfer delays review of the room inventory and delivery of the inspection report while the inspector is completing a property handover.
interruptionImpact: Interrupting a large video upload requires another transfer attempt and delays the inspection workflow. The app retains the original capture and stable identity for retry; it does not discard evidence because a transfer fails.
status: Demonstration deployed and verified by SHA-256 and HTTP 206 range response; Network processing: Other and the video link are saved in Play Publishing overview. This file is an answer sheet, not an API request.
